checks.detail: All five inputs present; every component published by availability; no vendor fallback.
Four observed quarters sum to original annual values within source rounding tolerance.
Byte-for-byte unchanged against inherited input hashes.
Every source component strictly predates the first day of the decision month; 550/275-day age limits.
No monthly gaps; weights, positions, turnover, costs and 1-9 bounds reconcile.
Costs equal specified bps times actual absolute traded value.
Unmodified baseline financial inputs reproduce prior NAV, return, CAGR, drawdown and costs.

known_limits: Original-report financial coverage exists for 18 of 31 retrospective candidates.
Some reporters/quarters are missing and 23 observed reports cannot form all required trailing flows.
Numerical source verification is not an independent audit of issuer accounts or vendors.
Actual releases reduce timing bias; they do not remove retrospective-universe or historical experiment-selection bias.
Monthly risk statistics do not capture all intramonth drawdowns.
